Add a figure-arithmetic cross-check rule: for every figure with numeric annotations, require the reviewer to recompute the annotation from the figure's own axis/caption and from the canonical ledger, and to mark the finding REPRODUCED only if the rendered annotation, caption, and ledger disagree beyond stated rounding.

Add a host-screen denominator rule: for every host-count or break-even finding, require explicit fields for screen type (KV residency, prefill compute, decode bandwidth, policy derate, N-1 spare, case i/ii/iii), population (working vs provisioned hosts), and operating point (average vs peak), so models stop conflating 19/21/22/29/31/32/34 counts.
